newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BOURSE SEEN UP AFTER TWO-SESSION FALL.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BOURSE SEEN UP AFTER TWO-SESSION FALL.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to rebound after a two-session fall, signalled by Monday's strong post-price-fixing buying, and analysts said the market, currently at 14,143.8 points, could soon test 14,500.

They said the market mood was good, in part because of expectations that institutions would resume buying in January, but that the central bank's threat to lift interest rates might dampen some demand.
Analysts said the parallel market's Echo Investment should extend Monday's surge after it reaffirmed it would sell a subsidiary. -- Steven Silber +48 22 653 9700
